attrs.note: ABORTED at P4.7 before any Go work began. The run was TRVM-BLIND-IMPLEMENTATION-RUN-v1, whose `status: FROZEN` pinned a RELEASE and nothing else: no candidate source digest, no binary digest, no environment, no instrument digest and no package identity. Three of those gaps were independently demonstrated to be exploitable — forcing every real predicate true in the scorer left this record green; editing requirements/open/, which the contract hands to the implementer, left it green; and the adapter registry lived in the runner's own source, so registering Go would have meant editing the measuring instrument after the challenge set existed. A run that cannot notice any of those is not a frozen experiment, and continuing under it would have produced a measurement whose meaning could not be stated. Superseded by a TRVM-BLIND-IMPLEMENTATION-RUN-v2 record pinning srel + bpkg + instrument_digest + per-subject package digests.
